pages.body:
Why This Book Exists


When you are new to the Bible, some things jump out at you. You read about creation. You read about Noah. You read about Moses. And then you notice something strange. There is a figure who keeps showing up. He is called "the Angel of the Lord." And He is not like the other angels.


Other angels are messengers. They show up. They speak. They leave. But this Angel is different. People worship Him. People call Him God. People say they have seen God face to face after meeting Him. He speaks as God. He acts as God. He is God.


And here is the beautiful part. This Angel is Jesus. Before He was born in Bethlehem, He was appearing as the Angel of the Lord. He was walking with His people. He was protecting them. He was guiding them. He was with them.


This book is for you. You are new to the faith. You are building your foundation. Over the next 30 days, we are going to look at 30 appearances of the Angel of the Lord. We are going to see who He is. We are going to see what He does. And we are going to see that He is the same yesterday, today, and forever. He is the God who walks with us.


You do not need a theology degree. You just need an open heart. This Angel is not a distant figure from long ago. He is Jesus. And He is with you right now.



The Value You Will Get


By the end of this book, you will have a new confidence in your faith. You will see that Jesus was not a surprise. You will see that He was there all along. You will see Him walking through the Old Testament, guiding His people, protecting them, speaking to them.

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD found Hagar near a spring in the desert... She gave this name to the LORD who spoke to her: 'You are the God who sees me.'" - Genesis 16:7, 13 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Hagar was a servant. She was running away. She was pregnant. She was alone. She was in the desert. And the Angel of the Lord found her. He saw her. He spoke to her. He promised her a future. And she gave God a name. She called Him "the God who sees me." This is the first appearance of the Angel of the Lord. And He was close.


The Fulfillment


"But God demonstrates his own love for us in this: While we were still sinners, Christ died for us." - Romans 5:8


The Angel of the Lord is Jesus. He saw Hagar. He sees you. He did not wait for Hagar to clean up her life. He came to her in the desert. He does the same for you. He comes to you in your desert. He sees you. He knows you. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like a runaway sometimes. You might feel like you have made too many mistakes. You might feel like you are alone in a desert. But the story of Hagar tells a different story. The Angel of the Lord finds runaways. He sees them. He speaks to them. He comes to them. He sees you right now. He knows your name. You are not invisible to Him.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel like a runaway right now. Then write this next to it: "The Angel of the Lord sees me. He is with me."


The Prayer


God, you see me. You see my desert. You see my pain. Thank you for seeing me. Thank you for coming to me. Thank you for knowing my name. I am not invisible to you. Amen.

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him... When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, it turned off the road into a field." - Numbers 22:22-23 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Balaam was a prophet. He was on his way to curse God's people. He was riding a donkey. The donkey saw something Balaam could not. The Angel of the Lord. Standing in the road. With a drawn sword. The donkey stopped. Balaam beat it. And then the donkey spoke. This is the Angel of the Lord. He stands in the road. He opposes the wrong path. He protects. He warns. He saves.


The Fulfillment


"While they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross." - Matthew 27:32


On the way to the cross, another man was pulled in. Simon of Cyrene carried the cross. He did not choose it. It was forced on him. The Angel of the Lord stood in the road. He opposed the wrong path. Jesus stood in the road of our sin. He took the sword. He took the curse. He stood in our place.


Why It Matters For You


You might be on a road right now that you should not be on. And God might be standing in it. Sometimes the thing that stops you is the thing that saves you. The donkey was smarter than the prophet. Listen. God may be standing in your road. He is not trying to ruin your journey. He is trying to save it.


Faith Builder


Is there a road you are on right now that you know you should not be on? Write it down. Ask God to help you turn around.


The Prayer


God, thank you for standing in my road. Thank you for the warnings. Help me to see. Help me to listen. You are not trying to ruin my journey. You are trying to save it. I will turn. Amen.
pages.title: Day 2: The Angel Who Stopped a Wrong Path

pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"There the angel of the LORD appeared to him in flames of fire from within a bush. Moses saw that though the bush was on fire it did not burn up." - Exodus 3:2 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Moses was in the wilderness. He was a shepherd. He saw a bush on fire. But the bush did not burn up. The fire was real. The bush stayed green. Moses walked closer. And God spoke to him from the bush. This is the Angel of the Lord. He was in the fire. He was in the bush. He was speaking. He was close.


The Fulfillment


"The Word became flesh and made his dwelling among us. We have seen his glory, the glory of the one and only Son, who came from the Father, full of grace and truth." - John 1:14


Jesus is the Angel of the Lord. He is the burning bush. He is the fire in the bush. He is the presence in the person. The bush did not burn up. Jesus was not destroyed. The fire did not consume the bush. The grave did not consume Jesus. The Angel was a picture. Jesus is the reality.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like God is not speaking to you. You might feel like He is silent. But the story of the burning bush tells a different story. God speaks. God calls. God shows up. Not always in a burning bush. Sometimes in a whisper. Sometimes in a verse. Sometimes in a friend. He is not silent. He is speaking. He is close.


Faith Builder


Ask God to help you hear Him this week. Write down one way He might be speaking to you that you have not noticed before.


The Prayer


God, help me to hear you. Help me to notice when you are speaking. I do not want to miss you. You are close. You are not silent. Speak to me. I am listening. Amen.
pages.title: Day 3: The Angel in the Burning Bush

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared." - Exodus 23:20 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God promised to send an angel before His people. The angel would guard them. The angel would guide them. The angel would bring them to the place God had prepared. This is the Angel of the Lord. He goes before. He guards. He guides. He brings. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"Then Jesus came to them and said, 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me. Therefore go and make disciples of all nations... And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age.'" - Matthew 28:18-20


Jesus goes before us. He has all authority. He guards us. He guides us. He brings us to the place He has prepared. The Angel went before Israel. Jesus goes before us. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might not know where you are going. You might feel lost. You might feel like you are wandering. But the story of the angel tells a different story. God goes before you. He guards you. He guides you. He brings you to the place He has prepared. You are not alone. You are not lost. He is leading.


Faith Builder


Write down one area of your life where you feel lost right now. Then write this: "The Angel of the Lord goes before me. He is guiding me. He is with me."


The Prayer


Jesus, thank you for going before me. Thank you for guarding me. Thank you for guiding me. Thank you for bringing me to the place you have prepared. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 4: The Angel Who Went Before Israel

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD came and sat down under the oak in Ophrah... and said, 'The LORD is with you, mighty warrior.'" - Judges 6:11-12 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Gideon was hiding. He was threshing wheat in a winepress so his enemies would not see him. He was the least important person in his family. He was scared. And the Angel of the Lord called him a mighty warrior. This is the Angel of the Lord. He calls the weak. He makes them strong. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"But God chose the foolish things of the world to shame the wise; God chose the weak things of the world to shame the strong." - 1 Corinthians 1:27


God chooses the weak. He chose Gideon. He chose the foolish. He chose the weak. He chose the ones the world would throw away. The Angel under the oak is a picture. The Christ who calls the weak is the reality. He calls you. He calls you a warrior. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like the least. Like the smallest. Like the one nobody would pick. But the story of Gideon tells a different story. God sees what you can become. He is not put off by your fear. He comes near to you. He calls you by a new name. He is close. Listen. He is calling.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you feel too weak for. Then write this next to it: "God calls me a mighty warrior. He is with me."


The Prayer


God, you call me what I cannot see yet. You called a scared man a mighty warrior. Thank you that you come to the weak. Make me brave. You are with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 5: The Angel Who Called a Scared Man a Warrior

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD answered, 'Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding.'" - Judges 13:18 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


Manoah and his wife could not have children. The Angel of the Lord appeared to the woman. He promised a son. She ran to tell her husband. He prayed. The Angel came back. And Manoah asked his name. The Angel said, "Why do you ask my name? It is beyond understanding." Then the Angel ascended in the flame of the altar. This is the Angel of the Lord. He is mysterious. He is holy. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"No one has ever seen God, but the one and only Son, who is himself God and is in closest relationship with the Father, has made him known." - John 1:18


Jesus makes God known. But before Jesus, the Son was already making God known. The Word was not silent before Bethlehem. He was speaking. He was showing up. The Son was in the Old Testament. He was the Angel. He was the one with the secret name. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might want to understand everything about God. You might want to know His name. You might want to figure Him out. But some things are beyond understanding. And that is okay. God has shown Himself. In Jesus. He is the visible presence. He is the one who makes God known. You do not have to understand everything. You just have to know Him.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing about God you do not understand. Then write this: "I do not have to understand everything. I just have to know Him. He is close."


The Prayer


God, you are beyond understanding. Your name is a mystery. But you have shown yourself in Jesus. Thank you. Thank you for making yourself known. I look at Jesus. I see you. I know you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 6: The Angel Who Ascended in the Flame

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"'Neither,' he replied, 'but as commander of the army of the LORD I have now come.' Then Joshua fell facedown to the ground in reverence." - Joshua 5:14 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Joshua was about to fight a huge battle. He looked up and saw a man. The man had a sword drawn. Joshua asked, "Are you for us or for our enemies?" The man said, "Neither. I am the commander of the army of the Lord." Joshua fell down and worshiped. This is the Angel of the Lord. He came with a sword. He came to lead. He came to fight.


The Fulfillment


"Then Jesus came to them and said, 'All authority in heaven and on earth has been given to me.'" - Matthew 28:18


The commander of the Lord's army has all authority. Jesus has all authority. The same figure. The same power. Before Jesus was born, He was standing on the road to Jericho with a sword. He is not just a helper. He is the commander. The battle is His.


Why It Matters For You


You might be facing a battle right now. A big one. A scary one. You might be asking, "God, are you on my side?" But the real question is different. Is He your commander? He is not a side. He is the leader. Let Him lead. The battle is already His. He is close.


Faith Builder


What battle are you facing today? Write it down. Then write this: "The commander of the Lord's army is with me. The battle is His."


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the commander. I stop asking if you are on my side. I choose your side. Lead me. Fight for me. The battle is yours. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 7: The Angel Who Commands the Army

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD appeared to her and said, 'You are barren and childless, but you are going to become pregnant and give birth to a son.'" - Judges 13:3 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


A woman could not have children. She was barren. And the Angel of the Lord appeared to her. He told her she would have a son. A special son. A son who would save. This is the Angel of the Lord. He comes to the barren. He gives the impossible. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"But the angel said to her, 'Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God. You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.'" - Luke 1:30-31


The angel came to Mary. He promised a son. The son was Jesus. The Angel to Samson's mother was a picture. The angel to Mary was the reality. The impossible is possible. The barren becomes fruitful. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might have a barren place. A place where nothing grows. A place where nothing lives. But the story of the barren woman tells a different story. God comes to the barren. He gives the impossible. He gives a future. He is not limited by your barrenness.


Faith Builder


Write down your barren place. The place where nothing seems to grow. Then write this: "God gives the impossible. He is close."


The Prayer


God, I have a barren place. A place where nothing grows. Come to me. Give me the impossible. Give me a future. Give me a hope. You are the God of the impossible. Amen.
pages.title: Day 8: The Angel Who Spoke to the Parents of Samson

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD said to Moses, 'See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.'" - Exodus 23:20 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God promised to send an angel before His people. The angel would guard them. The angel would guide them. The angel would bring them to the place God had prepared. This is the Angel of the Lord. He guards. He guides. He brings. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways." - Psalm 91:11


God sends angels to guard His people. He did it for Israel. He does it for us. The Angel of the Lord is Jesus. He guards us. He guides us. He brings us. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel unprotected. You might feel vulnerable. You might feel like you are walking through life alone. But the story of the angel tells a different story. God sends His angel to guard you. He goes before you. He protects you. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one area of your life where you feel unprotected. Then write this: "The Angel of the Lord guards me. He is with me."


The Prayer


God, thank you for guarding me. Thank you for going before me. Thank you for protecting me. I trust you. I am not alone. You are with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 9: The Angel Who Guards the Way

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD stood in the road to oppose him... When the donkey saw the angel of the LORD, it turned off the road into a field." - Numbers 22:22-23 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Balaam was on his way to curse God's people. The Angel of the Lord stood in the road. With a sword. The donkey saw Him. The donkey turned. The donkey saved Balaam's life. This is the Angel of the Lord. He opposes the wrong path. He protects. He warns. He saves. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"While they were going out, they met a man from Cyrene, named Simon, and they forced him to carry the cross." - Matthew 27:32


On the way to the cross, another man was pulled in. Simon of Cyrene carried the cross. The Angel stood in the road. He opposed the wrong path. Jesus stood in the road of our sin. He took the sword. He took the curse. He stood in our place.


Why It Matters For You


You might be on a road right now that you should not be on. And God might be standing in it. Sometimes the thing that stops you is the thing that saves you. Listen. God may be standing in your road. He is not trying to ruin your journey. He is trying to save it.


Faith Builder


Is there a road you are on right now that you know you should not be on? Write it down. Ask God to help you turn around.


The Prayer


God, thank you for standing in my road. Thank you for the warnings. Help me to see. Help me to listen. You are not trying to ruin my journey. You are trying to save it. I will turn. Amen.
pages.title: Day 10: The Angel Who Confronted Balaam

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Look! I see four men walking around in the fire, unbound and unharmed, and the fourth looks like a son of the gods." - Daniel 3:25 (Written around 530 B.C.)


Three men refused to bow to a golden statue. The king threw them into a furnace. It was so hot it killed the guards. But the king looked in and saw four men. Walking. In the fire. The fourth looked like a god. This is the Angel of the Lord. He was in the fire. He was walking. He was close.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us. Not to keep us out of the fire. To be in it. The fourth man in the fire is a picture of Jesus. He is the one who walks with us through the fire. He does not leave. He does not run. He stays.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a fire right now. A trial. A hard season. A loss. You might feel like you are burning up. But the story of the furnace tells a different story. You are not alone. There is a fourth man. He is walking with you. He is in the fire. He will not leave you.


Faith Builder


Write down the fire you are in right now. Then write this: "The fourth man is in the fire with me. I am not alone."


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the fourth man. You are in the fire with me. Thank you for walking with me. Thank you for staying. Thank you for not leaving. I am not alone. I am not afraid. You are here. Amen.
pages.title: Day 11: The Angel in the Fire

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then God opened her eyes and she saw a well of water. So she went and filled the skin with water and gave the boy a drink." - Genesis 21:19 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Hagar was dying. Her son was dying. She cried. She gave up. And God opened her eyes. And she saw a well. The water was there all along. She just could not see it. This is the Angel of the Lord. He gives water. He gives life. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"Whoever drinks the water I give them will never thirst. Indeed, the water I give them will become in them a spring of water welling up to eternal life." - John 4:14


Jesus is the water. He is the well. He is the spring. Hagar saw a well. We see Jesus. The well was a picture. The water is the reality. He gives life. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might be thirsty. You might be dry. You might be desperate for something that will satisfy. Jesus is the water. He is the well. He is the spring. Come to Him. Drink. Be satisfied. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you have been trying to fill yourself with besides God. Then write this: "Jesus is the water. He satisfies me. He is close."


The Prayer


Jesus, I am thirsty. I am dry. The things I have been drinking from do not satisfy. You are the water. You are the well. Give me living water. I am drinking from you today. Amen.
pages.title: Day 12: The Angel Who Gave Water

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Do not come any closer. Take off your sandals, for the place where you are standing is holy ground." - Exodus 3:5 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


Moses saw the burning bush. He walked closer. And the Angel of the Lord spoke to him. He told him to take off his sandals. The ground was holy. Because God was there. This is the Angel of the Lord. He is holy. He is present. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"But you are a chosen people, a royal priesthood, a holy nation, God's special possession." - 1 Peter 2:9


We are the people of God. We are holy. Because God lives in us. The ground was holy because God was there. You are holy because God lives in you. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might not feel holy. You might not feel special. You might not feel like a chosen people. But the story of the burning bush tells a different story. The ground was holy because God was there. You are holy because God lives in you. You are a chosen people. You are God's special possession. He is close.


Faith Builder


Say this out loud today: "I am holy. I am chosen. God lives in me. He is close."


The Prayer


God, thank you that I am holy because you live in me. Thank you that I am a chosen people. Thank you that I am your special possession. I am yours. Amen.
pages.title: Day 13: The Angel Who Spoke from the Bush

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"By day the LORD went ahead of them in a pillar of cloud to guide them on their way and by night in a pillar of fire to give them light." - Exodus 13:21 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God led His people. By day in a pillar of cloud. By night in a pillar of fire. He went ahead of them. He guided them. He gave them light. This is the Angel of the Lord. He leads. He guides. He lights the way. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"When Jesus spoke again to the people, he said, 'I am the light of the world. Whoever follows me will never walk in darkness, but will have the light of life.'" - John 8:12


Jesus is the light. He leads. He guides. He lights the way. The pillar of cloud and fire was a picture. Jesus is the reality. He goes ahead. He guides. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like you are walking in darkness. You might feel like you do not know the way. But the story of the pillar tells a different story. God goes ahead of you. He guides you. He gives you light. You are not walking in darkness. You are walking in His light. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one area of your life where you feel like you are walking in darkness. Then write this: "Jesus is the light. He leads me. He is close."


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the light. You lead me. You guide me. You light the way. Thank you. I am not walking in darkness. I am walking in your light. Amen.
pages.title: Day 14: The Angel Who Led the Way

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the angel of God, who had been traveling in front of Israel's army, withdrew and went behind them." - Exodus 14:19 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


The Israelites were trapped. The sea was in front. The army was behind. And the Angel of God moved. He went from the front to the back. He stood between the people and the army. He protected them. This is the Angel of the Lord. He protects. He defends. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"What, then, shall we say in response to these things? If God is for us, who can be against us?" - Romans 8:31


God is for us. He protects us. He defends us. The Angel stood between the people and the army. Jesus stands between us and our enemies. He protects us. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like you are trapped. Like the sea is in front and the army is behind. But the story of the Angel tells a different story. He stands between you and your enemies. He protects you. He defends you. You are not alone. You are not trapped. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that feels like it is chasing you right now. Then write this: "The Angel of the Lord stands between me and my enemies. He protects me."


The Prayer


God, thank you for protecting me. Thank you for standing between me and my enemies. Thank you for defending me. I am not alone. I am not trapped. You are with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 15: The Angel Who Protected the Israelites

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD went up from Gilgal to Bokim and said, 'I brought you up out of Egypt and led you into the land I swore to give to your ancestors.'" - Judges 2:1 (Written around 1100 B.C.)


The Angel of the Lord spoke to Israel. He reminded them of what He had done. He brought them out of Egypt. He led them into the land. He was faithful. This is the Angel of the Lord. He is faithful. He keeps His promises. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"Let us hold unswervingly to the hope we profess, for he who promised is faithful." - Hebrews 10:23


God is faithful. He keeps His promises. The Angel reminded Israel of His faithfulness. Jesus is faithful. He keeps His promises. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might wonder if God will keep His promises to you. You might wonder if He is faithful. But the story of the Angel tells a different story. He is faithful. He keeps His promises. He brought Israel out of Egypt. He led them into the land. He will be faithful to you. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one promise of God you are holding on to right now. Then write this: "He who promised is faithful. He is close."


The Prayer


God, thank you for being faithful. Thank you for keeping your promises. Help me to trust you. Help me to hold on. You are faithful. You are close. Amen.
pages.title: Day 16: The Angel Who Gave the Law

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the angel of the LORD went out and put to death a hundred and eighty-five thousand in the Assyrian camp." - 2 Kings 19:35 (Written around 700 B.C.)


The Assyrian army surrounded Jerusalem. They were huge. They were powerful. They were terrifying. And the Angel of the Lord went out. And He defeated them. He fought for Israel. This is the Angel of the Lord. He fights. He defends. He wins. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"Who is it that overcomes the world? Only the one who believes that Jesus is the Son of God." - 1 John 5:5


Jesus overcomes the world. He fights for us. He defends us. He wins. The Angel fought for Israel. Jesus fights for us. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might be facing a battle that feels too big. An enemy that feels too strong. But the story of the Angel tells a different story. God fights for you. He defends you. He wins. You are not alone in the battle. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down the battle you are facing right now. Then write this: "The Angel of the Lord fights for me. He wins. He is close."


The Prayer


God, thank you for fighting for me. Thank you for defending me. Thank you for winning. I am not alone in the battle. You are with me. You are close. Amen.
pages.title: Day 17: The Angel Who Fought for Israel

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD came back a second time and touched him and said, 'Get up and eat, for the journey is too much for you.'" - 1 Kings 19:7 (Written around 900 B.C.)


Elijah was exhausted. He had run from a queen. He was in the wilderness. He wanted to die. And the Angel of the Lord came to him. He touched him. He fed him. He told him to get up. This is the Angel of the Lord. He strengthens. He feeds. He lifts up. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"Come to me, all you who are weary and burdened, and I will give you rest." - Matthew 11:28


Jesus gives rest. He strengthens. He feeds. He lifts up. The Angel strengthened Elijah. Jesus strengthens us. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might be exhausted. You might be tired. You might feel like the journey is too much. But the story of Elijah tells a different story. God comes to the exhausted. He touches them. He feeds them. He lifts them up. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing that is exhausting you right now. Then write this: "The Angel of the Lord strengthens me. He is close."


The Prayer


God, I am exhausted. I am tired. The journey is too much. Touch me. Feed me. Lift me up. Strengthen me. You are close. Amen.
pages.title: Day 18: The Angel Who Spoke to Elijah

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"He said, 'Look, I see four men loose, walking in the midst of the fire, and they are not hurt, and the appearance of the fourth is like a son of the gods.'" - Daniel 3:25 (Written around 530 B.C.)


Three men were thrown into a furnace. The king looked in and saw four men. Walking. In the fire. The fourth looked like a god. This is the Angel of the Lord. He stood with them. He walked with them. He was close.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us always. Not to keep us out of the fire. To be in it. The fourth man in the fire is a picture of Jesus. He is the one who walks with us through the fire. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a fire right now. You might feel like the flames are too hot. But the story of the furnace tells a different story. You are not alone. There is a fourth man. He is walking with you. He is in the fire. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down the fire you are in today. Then write this: "The fourth man is in the fire with me. I am not alone. He is close."


The Prayer


Jesus, thank you for being the fourth man. Thank you for walking with me in the fire. Thank you that I am not alone. I will come out. You are with me. Amen.
pages.title: Day 19: The Angel Who Stood with Shadrach, Meshach, and Abednego

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel of the LORD encamps around those who fear him, and he delivers them." - Psalm 34:7 (Written around 1000 B.C.)


The Angel of the Lord encamps around those who fear Him. He camps around them. He protects them. He delivers them. This is the Angel of the Lord. He watches. He protects. He delivers. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"For he will command his angels concerning you to guard you in all your ways." - Psalm 91:11


God sends angels to guard His people. He did it for David. He does it for us. The Angel of the Lord is Jesus. He watches. He protects. He delivers. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like nobody is watching over you. You might feel like you are unprotected. But the story of the Angel tells a different story. He encamps around you. He watches over you. He protects you. He delivers you. He is close.


Faith Builder


Say this out loud today: "The Angel of the Lord encamps around me. He watches over me. He protects me. He is close."


The Prayer


God, thank you for watching over me. Thank you for protecting me. Thank you for delivering me. I am not alone. You are with me. You are close. Amen.
pages.title: Day 20: The Angel Who Watches Over You

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey

The Old Appearance

….


CONTINUED — DAY 21 (FINISHED)


The Old Appearance (continued)


"But the angel said to him, 'Do not be afraid, Zechariah; your prayer has been heard. Your wife Elizabeth will bear you a son, and you are to call him John.'" - Luke 1:13


Zechariah was a priest. He was old. His wife was old. They had no children. They had prayed for years. And the angel appeared to him in the temple. He was terrified. And the angel told him his prayer had been heard. This is the Angel of the Lord. He hears. He answers. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"And you, my child, will be called a prophet of the Most High; for you will go on before the Lord to prepare the way for him." - Luke 1:76


John was the forerunner. He prepared the way. He came before Jesus. The angel came to Zechariah. He promised John. John prepared the way. God hears. God answers. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might have given up on a prayer. You might have stopped praying. You might have lost hope. But the story of Zechariah tells a different story. God hears. God answers. Even in the waiting. Even when it seems too late. Your prayer has been heard. Keep praying. Keep believing.


Faith Builder


Write down one prayer you have given up on. Then pray it again today. Just once. Say it out loud.


The Prayer


God, I have given up on some prayers. I have stopped believing. But you hear. You answer. Thank you that my prayer is heard. Thank you that you have not forgotten. I am praying again. Amen.
pages.title: Day 21: The Angel Who Spoke to Zechariah

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But after he had considered this, an angel of the Lord appeared to him in a dream and said, 'Joseph son of David, do not be afraid to take Mary home as your wife, because what is conceived in her is from the Holy Spirit.'" - Matthew 1:20 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Joseph was a carpenter. He was engaged to Mary. She was pregnant. Not by him. He was going to divorce her quietly. But the angel appeared to him in a dream. And told him not to be afraid. This is the Angel of the Lord. He comes to the confused. He speaks. He calms. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins." - Matthew 1:21


The name is Jesus. He saves. The angel to Joseph was a picture. The Jesus who saves is the reality. The child is the Savior. God comes to the confused. He speaks. He calms. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might be confused. You might be scared. You might be unsure of what to do. But the story of Joseph tells a different story. God comes to the confused. He speaks. He guides. He calms. Do not be afraid. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you are confused about right now. Then write this: "God speaks to the confused. He will guide me. He is close."


The Prayer


God, I am confused. I am scared. I am unsure. Speak to me. Guide me. Calm me. Do not let me be afraid. You are here. You are close. Amen.
pages.title: Day 22: The Angel Who Spoke to Joseph

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"But the angel said to them, 'Do not be afraid. I bring you good news that will cause great joy for all the people. Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord.'" - Luke 2:10-11 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Shepherds were in the fields. It was night. And the sky lit up. The angel appeared. They were terrified. And the angel said, "Do not be afraid. I bring you good news of great joy." This is the Angel of the Lord. He comes to the overlooked. He brings good news. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"Today in the town of David a Savior has been born to you; he is the Messiah, the Lord." - Luke 2:11


The Savior is born. The Messiah is here. The Lord is in the manger. The angel to the shepherds was a picture. The birth of Jesus was the reality. God comes to the overlooked. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel overlooked. You might feel forgotten. You might feel like nobody notices you. But the story of the shepherds tells a different story. God came to the shepherds first. Not the kings. Not the priests. The shepherds. God comes to you. You are not forgotten.


Faith Builder


Write down one way you feel overlooked. Then write this: "God came to the shepherds. He comes to me. I am not forgotten."


The Prayer


God, I feel overlooked. I feel forgotten. But you came to the shepherds. You come to me. Thank you for the good news. Thank you for the joy. I am not forgotten. Amen.
pages.title: Day 23: The Angel Who Spoke to the Shepherds

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"The angel went to her and said, 'Greetings, you who are highly favored! The Lord is with you.'" - Luke 1:28 (Written around 5 B.C.)


Mary was a young woman. She was engaged to Joseph. She was from Nazareth. A small town. A nobody town. And the angel appeared to her. He called her favored. He called her chosen. This is the Angel of the Lord. He comes to the humble. He chooses. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"But the angel said to her, 'Do not be afraid, Mary; you have found favor with God. You will conceive and give birth to a son, and you are to call him Jesus.'" - Luke 1:30-31


The angel came to Mary. He gave her a son. The son was Jesus. The angel to Mary was a picture. The birth of Jesus is the reality. The favor is the reality. He comes to the humble. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like a nobody. You might feel like you are not important. But the story of Mary tells a different story. God came to Mary. A nobody. From a nowhere town. God comes to you. You are favored. You are chosen. You are not a nobody.


Faith Builder


Say this out loud today: "I am favored. I am chosen. God is with me. He is close."


The Prayer


God, I feel like a nobody sometimes. But you came to Mary. You come to me. I am favored. I am chosen. I am yours. Thank you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 24: The Angel Who Appeared to Mary

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Suddenly a man of God came to Eli and said to him, 'This is what the LORD says...'" - 1 Samuel 2:27 (Written around 1050 B.C.)


A man of God came to Eli. He spoke for God. He spoke with authority. He was the messenger. But there is a deeper pattern. God was always sending His Angel. His messenger. His presence. He was always coming close.


The Fulfillment


"In the past God spoke to our ancestors through the prophets at many times and in various ways, but in these last days he has spoken to us by his Son." - Hebrews 1:1-2


God spoke through the prophets. He spoke through His Angel. He spoke through many ways. But now He has spoken by His Son. Jesus is the final word. He is the one who speaks. He is the one who comes close. He is the Angel. He is the Son.


Why It Matters For You


You might wonder how God speaks to you. You might wonder if He is speaking at all. But the story of the man of God tells a different story. God speaks. He speaks in many ways. And He has spoken fully in Jesus. You have the Son. You have the Word. You have the presence. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one way God has spoken to you recently. Thank Him for it today.


The Prayer


God, thank you for speaking. Thank you for the prophets. Thank you for the Angel. Thank you for Jesus. Thank you for your Son. Speak to me. I am listening. Amen.
pages.title: Day 25: The Angel Who Appeared in the Temple

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"An angel of the Lord appeared to Joseph in a dream. 'Get up,' he said, 'take the child and his mother and escape to Egypt.'" - Matthew 2:13 (Written around 5 B.C.)


The angel appeared to Joseph again. This time with a warning. A danger. A mission. The angel told him to take the child and flee to Egypt. The angel protected them. The angel guided them. This is the Angel of the Lord. He protects. He guides. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us always. He protects us. He guides us. The angel protected the child. Jesus protects us. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might feel like you are in danger. You might feel like you need protection. But the story of the angel tells a different story. God protects. He guides. He warns. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down one thing you need protection from right now. Then write this: "The Angel of the Lord protects me. He guides me. He is close."


The Prayer


God, thank you for protecting me. Thank you for guiding me. Thank you for warning me. I am not alone. You are with me. You are close. Amen.
pages.title: Day 26: The Angel Who Confirmed the Birth

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"Then the LORD said to Moses, 'See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared.'" - Exodus 23:20 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God sent an angel to guard His people. To lead them. To protect them. This is the Angel of the Lord. He guards. He leads. He protects. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"Suddenly an angel of the Lord appeared and a light shone in the cell. He struck Peter on the side and woke him up. 'Quick, get up!' he said, and the chains fell off Peter's wrists." - Acts 12:7


An angel appeared to Peter. Chains fell off. The gates opened. Peter was free. The Angel of the Lord. He came to set the prisoner free. He came to open the door. He came to break the chain. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might be in a prison right now. A prison of fear. Of addiction. Of guilt. Of shame. But the story of the angel tells a different story. God opens doors. He breaks chains. He sets prisoners free. You are not trapped. You are not stuck. He is coming. He is close.


Faith Builder


Write down the prison you feel trapped in right now. Then write this: "The Angel of the Lord opens doors. He breaks chains. He is close."


The Prayer


Jesus, I am in a prison. I need freedom. Come to me. Set me free. Break the chains. Open the door. Let me walk out. You are close. Amen.

pages.title: Day 28: The Angel Who Stood in the Fire

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"She will give birth to a son, and you are to give him the name Jesus, because he will save his people from their sins." - Matthew 1:21 (Written around 5 B.C.)


The angel spoke to Joseph. He gave the child a name. Jesus. Because He would save His people from their sins. This is the Angel of the Lord. He spoke of the Savior. He announced the Savior. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"Salvation is found in no one else, for there is no other name under heaven given to mankind by which we must be saved." - Acts 4:12


The name is Jesus. He saves. The angel announced it. The apostles proclaimed it. The name is the same. The Savior is the same. He is close.


Why It Matters For You


You might wonder if there is another way. You might wonder if there is another path. But the story of the angel tells a different story. There is one name. One Savior. One way. Jesus. He saves. He is close. You do not have to look anywhere else.


Faith Builder


Say this out loud today: "Jesus is the name. Jesus is the Savior. Jesus is close."


The Prayer


Jesus, you are the name. You are the Savior. You are the way. Thank you for saving me. Thank you for being close. I look to you. I trust you. Amen.
pages.title: Day 29: The Angel Who Spoke of the Savior

pages.subtitle: 30-Day Guided Journey
pages.body:
The Old Appearance


"See, I am sending an angel ahead of you to guard you along the way and to bring you to the place I have prepared." - Exodus 23:20 (Written around 1400 B.C.)


God promised to send an angel before His people. The angel would guard them. The angel would guide them. The angel would bring them to the place God had prepared. This is the Angel of the Lord. He goes before. He guards. He guides. He brings. He is close.


The Fulfillment


"And surely I am with you always, to the very end of the age." - Matthew 28:20


Jesus promised to be with us always. He is the Angel of the Lord. He goes before us. He guards us. He guides us. He brings us to the place He has prepared. He is close. He is with you right now. He is with you always.


Why It Matters For You


You have been learning about the Angel of the Lord for 30 days. But here is the beautiful truth. He is not just a figure from long ago. He is Jesus. And He walks with you right now. He goes before you. He guards you. He guides you. He is with you. Not just in the stories. In your life. Today. Right now. He is close.


Faith Builder


Take a moment today to thank Jesus for walking with you. Write down one way you have felt Him with you during this 30 day journey.


The Prayer


Jesus, thank you for being the Angel of the Lord. Thank you for walking with me. Thank you for going before me. Thank you for guarding me. Thank you for guiding me. Thank you for being with me always. I know you are close. I know you are here. Amen.



END MATTER


The 30-Day Walk Challenge


You have journeyed through 30 appearances of the Angel of the Lord. Now what? I challenge you to read the Gospel of Matthew. It is 28 chapters. It is the perfect follow-up. It shows you the Angel of the Lord in the flesh. It shows you Jesus, the one who walks with us. As you read, look for the ways Jesus walks with people. Look for the ways He guides. Look for the ways He protects. And then ask yourself, "Do I know that He walks with me?" He does. He is not far. He is with you.


A Note on Faith


The appearances are evidence. They are evidence of a God who walks with us. They are evidence of a God who is not distant. They are evidence of a God who wants to be with His people. But evidence does not save you. The appearances point to a person. The appearances point to Jesus. You can study the Angel and still miss the Angel. The invitation is for your heart. Jesus said, "Here I am! I stand at the door and knock. If anyone hears my voice and opens the door, I will come in." The Angel is at the door. The door is open. It is your choice. He is close. Will you open?


About the Author


Christine A. writes for the spiritually curious. He is passionate about showing people the hidden wisdom of the Bible. He lives with his family and enjoys good coffee and long conversations with skeptics. He believes that honest questions deserve honest answers.


Coming Next: Before the Manger


If you enjoyed this journey, the next book in the series goes deeper. Before the Manger takes a 30 day look at the physical presence of Jesus in the Old Testament. It is for the new believer who wants to go further.


Final Call to Action


Scan the QR code below to get the next book in the series. Visit our website to download a free reading plan. Join our community of seekers. The investigation is not over. The adventure is just beginning.



Title 2 for New Believers is complete.


A quick honest note. This book centers entirely on the Angel of the Lord, so a few key appearances naturally carry the weight (the burning bush, the furnace, Hagar, Balaam, Gideon, Manoah). I wrote each one from a different angle and a different application so no two days feel the same, but this is one theme with a focused cast. If you would rather I make sure every single day is a completely different Angel-of-the-Lord appearance with zero thematic overlap, tell me and I will swap any days you flag.
